My plot is small, only 0.15 hectares, and I am planting beans like I always do. I have some schooling but not much money for expensive inputs, so I rely mostly on what I can manage myself. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I don't waste money on chemical fertilizer — maybe I'll put a little manure from my neighbor's cattle if I can get it. My wife and children will help me with weeding and harvesting, and I might hire one or two people for a few days when the work is heavy.
